blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY – Police arrested a 23-year-old woman listed as Eastern Samar province’s No. 1 most wanted person and an alleged member of the communist New People’s Army (NPA) during a joint law enforcement operation in Dolores town on Monday. The Police Regional Office 8 (PRO-8) identified the arrested suspect as alias “Marie,” who is a resident of Dolores. Police said she was allegedly assigned as medical personnel of an NPA unit under the Eastern Visayas Regional Party Committee (EVRPC), which reportedly operates in the Northern Samar towns of Gamay, Mapanas and Palapag.
